title: Design System: SIA (CIMH Stores staff app)

identity.purpose: Customer or organisation name heading the request detail.

next-step.purpose: The one sentence saying what to do with the selected request.

body.purpose: Default UI text: rows, nav, forms.

label.purpose: Status chips, stage tabs, field labels.

panel-title.purpose: A panel's or drawer group's own heading, uppercase, muted.

mono.purpose: Ids, unit and shelf codes, counts, scan input; tabular figures.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: M3 level 1 under a filled pill button on hover only.

shadows.name: select-bar
shadows.purpose: Selection indicator on queue rows (left) and the active nav row (inset -2px, right); not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Arrivals: rows, counts, detail swap, view transitions (--ease-out).

motion.name: count-roll
motion.purpose: A changed count rolls into place.

motion.name: detail-swap
motion.purpose: Detail panel body when the selection changes.

motion.name: request-pane-transition
motion.purpose: View Transition when a request opens beside the queue, closes, or moves to its own page.

motion.name: nav-tooltip
motion.value: in 160/220ms ease-out; out 90ms ease-in; translateX(-6px) scale(0.98)

components.name: Primary Button (M3 pill)
components.description: The one filled action per panel: Start quoting, Approve, Send quote, Ship.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.00625em; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #5CC2FF; color: #0D1117; border: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #5CC2FF 92%, #0D1117); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-btn-primary:active, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, #5CC2FF 88%, #0D1117); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0084C8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside the primary pill; never lifts.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.00625em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-outlined { background: transparent; color: #5CC2FF; border: 1px solid #30363D; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(92,194,255,0.08); } .ds-btn-outlined:active, .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { background: rgba(92,194,255,0.12); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0084C8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action (Reject, Cancel), outlined in red and isolated from the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.00625em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #F97066; border: 1px solid rgba(249,112,102,0.5); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(249,112,102,0.08); } .ds-btn-danger:active, .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { background: rgba(249,112,102,0.12); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0084C8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Icon + sentence-case word + tone; a label, not a button. Neutral is outline only.
components.html: Awaiting agreement Delivered
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px 0 8px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 13px/1 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip svg { flex: none; } .ds-chip-warning { background: rgba(242,177,58,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(242,177,58,0.32); color: color-mix(in srgb, #F2B13A 72%, #E6EDF3); } .ds-chip-warning svg { fill: #F2B13A; } .ds-chip-success { background: rgba(63,185,80,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(63,185,80,0.32); color: color-mix(in srgb, #3FB950 72%, #E6EDF3); } .ds-chip-success svg { fill: #3FB950; }

components.name: Console Panel
components.description: Panel on graphite, 1 px seams, 44 px head with its own uppercase title.
components.html:
Needs you now

12
Rows go here.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #1C2026; border: 1px solid #30363D; border-radius: 4px; color: #E6EDF3; font: 400 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #30363D; } .ds-panel-head h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 11px/16px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #9DA7B3; } .ds-mono { font: 500 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #9DA7B3; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 16px; }

components.name: Queue Row
components.description: Work queue row: mono id, customer, reason with icon + word, waiting time; selected = wash + left bar.
components.html:
• R-2026-0142Barbados Met ServiceTo quote2 d
  • R-2026-0139Guyana Hydromet Pro BonoTo approve 5 d
components.css: .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #1C2026; color: #E6EDF3; font: 400 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(120px,0.9fr) minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,1fr) 72px; gap: 12px; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #30363D; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row:hover { background: #22272E; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0084C8; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-sel, .ds-sel:hover { background: #0B2A3D; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #5CC2FF; } .ds-code { font: 400 13px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-who { font-weight: 500; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; } .ds-why { font-size: 13px; } .ds-wait { display: inline-flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: #9DA7B3; } .ds-overdue { color: #F2B13A; font-weight: 600; } .ds-overdue svg { fill: currentColor; width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-pb { font: 600 11px/16px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #F5C400; color: #1A1A1A; }

components.name: Drawer Navigation
components.description: Grouped flat rows with counts; active = raised ground, bold label, blue icon, 2 px right bar.
components.html:
Work
DashboardRequests4Pick2
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 240px; background: #1C2026; border-right: 1px solid #30363D; padding: 16px 0; font: 400 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-grp { padding: 8px 16px 4px; font: 600 11px/16px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #9DA7B3; } .ds-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; color: #E6EDF3; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-item:hover { background: #22272E; } .ds-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0084C8; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-ic { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 4px; background: #9DA7B3; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-on { background: #22272E; box-shadow: inset -2px 0 0 #5CC2FF; font-weight: 600; } .ds-on .ds-ic { background: #5CC2FF; opacity: 1; } .ds-count { margin-left: auto; font: 500 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #9DA7B3; }

components.name: Stage Tabs
components.description: Request desk stages as one strip cut by seams; active = wash + blue underline; urgent = amber.
components.html: New 4Verify 2To ship 1
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border: 1px solid #30363D; border-radius: 4px; background: #1C2026; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 13px/18px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #9DA7B3; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tab + .ds-tab { border-left: 1px solid #30363D; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #22272E; color: #E6EDF3; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0084C8; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-active { background: #0B2A3D; color: #E6EDF3; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #5CC2FF; } .ds-n { font: 500 12px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #9DA7B3; } .ds-urgent, .ds-urgent .ds-n { color: #F2B13A; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Scan Field
components.description: Keyboard-wedge scan input: barcode icon, mono text, Enter submits one scan and keeps focus.
components.html: Scan the code, or type it and press Enter
components.css: .ds-scan { font: 400 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #E6EDF3; } .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 6px 0 12px; border: 1px solid #30363D; border-radius: 2px; background: #1C2026; color: #9DA7B3; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #9DA7B3; } .ds-field:focus-within { border: 2px solid #5CC2FF; padding-left: 11px; } .ds-field input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: none; border: 0; outline: 0; color: #E6EDF3; font: 400 13px/20px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-field button { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(92,194,255,0.12); color: #5CC2FF; font: 500 13px 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-field button:hover { background: rgba(92,194,255,0.2); } .ds-hint { margin: 4px 0 0 12px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: #9DA7B3; }

narrative.overview:
SIA is a working console, not a website. Panels sit on a graphite ground and stay put: the drawer, the work queue and the selected item's detail share the window, and navigating changes what the panels hold instead of replacing the page. Panels are cut apart by 1 px seams, not floated on shadows. Dark is the default (`storedTheme('cimhDark')`); the light theme mirrors it with white panels and pale seams.

Colour is reserved. Action blue marks the one primary action, the selected row and the active place; amber, red and green mean state (verify, expiring or failed, done) and always travel with an icon and a word. Everything else is ink, muted ink and seams. Type is compact Inter at 13 to 14 px for rows and controls; codes, counts and ids are set in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Panels name themselves with a small uppercase header.

Motion is quiet and functional: counts roll when they change, rows enter, leave and re-sort in place, the detail panel swaps in from the queue's side, and a View Transition morphs the request pane when it opens beside the queue or moves to its own page. Every motion has a reduced-motion path.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent panels on graphite, separated by 1 px seams, 4 px corners.
Colour only for state and the primary action; state is never colour alone.
Compact Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for codes, ids and figures.
Material 3 pill buttons beside square-cornered panels.
Dark by default, light as an equal mirror.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Amber, red and green appear only when something is in that state; a quiet queue is ink and seams. Stage tints and decorative colour were removed from the dashboard for this reason.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state colour carries an icon and a word: status chips (icon + sentence-case word), "Overdue" and "Expiring" in queue rows, the Next step sentence.

rules.name: The Codes-in-Mono Rule
rules.body: A value someone could scan, type or compare (ids, barcodes, counts) is set in JetBrains Mono with `tabular-nums`; prose and names never are.

rules.name: The Panel-Names-Itself Rule
rules.body: A panel's heading is its own small uppercase header in the 44 px head bar; it is the heading, not a label above another heading.

rules.name: The Seams-Not-Shadows Rule
rules.body: Panels at rest have no shadow; they are separated by a 1 px seam and a step on the tonal ladder. Shadow belongs to hover lift and floating overlays.

dos: Do separate panels with a 1 px seam and a step on the tonal ladder (ground, panel, raised).
Do keep the queue and the selected item's detail on screen together at 1280 px and wider.
Do give every state colour an icon and a word, using the shared status mapping.
Do make the current step's action the filled Action Blue pill and keep the rest outlined; put a destructive action outlined in red and apart from it.
Do set ids, codes and counts in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do head each panel with its own 11 px uppercase title in a 44 px head bar.
Do mark a selected row with Action Wash plus a 2 px Action Blue bar, and the current nav place with Graphite Raised plus the same bar.
Do give every animation a reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't put shadows on panels at rest; shadows are for hover lift and floating overlays (tooltips, menus, dialogs).
Don't use amber, red or green as decoration or as a stage tint.
Don't use Logo Blue for text, or Pro Bono Yellow with anything but ink text.
Don't round panels beyond 4 px or round nav rows into pills.
Don't hard-code colours that exist as theme tokens; read them from the Vuetify theme.
